name: Tata Chemicals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1939, Tata Chemicals Ltd manufactures and exports basic chemistry and specialty products [1]
keyPoints: Business Segments:[1] a) Basic Chemistry Products (79% in FY26 vs 81% in FY25):[2][3] The company manufactures essential inorganic products including soda ash, sodium bicarbonate, salt, bromine, caustic soda, and cement, catering to industries such as glass, detergents, food, pharmaceuticals, EVs, and chemicals. It is among the largest soda ash producers globally, ranking 3rd excluding China, and is the 5th-largest producer of sodium bicarbonate worldwide. It is also a market leader in salt across India and the UK.
pros: Stock is trading at 0.70 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 82.4%
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.41% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.59% over last 3 years.
